notes:
- **Changing an email draft changes that draft.** While a draft is waiting, ask for a new subject or
  a different line and the same card updates. You no longer get a second card with the whole email
  written again, and your agent knows the draft is still waiting for you. Nothing is sent until you
  press Send.
- **A reply to a draft card is a change to make.** Reply to the card with "also say I might be ten
  minutes late" and the draft is rewritten to say it. To put in your own words exactly as you type
  them, press Edit it, then Use my words.
- **Rewrite it for me works on a new email**, not only on a reply. Other versions is offered on
  replies, where it works.
- **Stopping something your agent watches happens straight away.** "Stop watching that" or "never
  mind, I don't need it" marks it as stopped without asking whether you are sure. You can ask your
  agent to undo it.
- **Taking something off one of your lists asks first.** Changes like checking something off or
  updating a price still happen right away, and your agent can undo them. A removal waits for your
  yes, because it is the one change that is hard to put back. A scheduled routine can change a list
  but never take anything off it.
- **Your agent checks your lists before saying something is not on them.** When a message names
  something you are tracking, your agent is shown it, so it no longer answers that it has no record
  of it.
- **While the message box is empty, the microphone and talk buttons sit where Send goes.**
- **Rules you wrote for your agent's personality stay with you** when you remove the personality
  before choosing a new one. The next one you pick starts with them.
